# op-safe: the doc map for agents

## This repo

- [docs/quickstart.md](docs/quickstart.md): the numbered path from
  nothing to a saved-and-cleaned secret, all commands copy-pasteable.
- [docs/how-to.md](docs/how-to.md): day-to-day operation, grouped by
  task: one secret to one script, per-account use, temp-root hygiene,
  cleanup traps on error paths, orphan audits.
- [docs/RUNBOOK.md](docs/RUNBOOK.md): the operator's reference: the full
  command surface, the environment, every error string with its fix,
  recovery procedures.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the boundary as rules an agent obeys.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, tests, the lint and docs
  gates, the change bar.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): vulnerability reporting, scope.
- skills/op-safe/SKILL.md: the skill form of the boundary.
- [examples/README.md](examples/README.md): the runnable mock
  walkthrough (`examples/demo-with-mock.sh`) with captured output.
- tests/: the bats suite (`tests/op-access.bats`) over the mock shim in
  `tests/mock/`, run by `tests/run-tests.sh`.

## The family (AI ECP)

- the family catalog (the map home; in the private control-plane repo).
- repo-guards: governance kit (gates, hooks, CI shape).
- actions-runner: agent pipeline kit (stages, gates, worklog).
- agent-workspace-kit: agent-team launcher.
- docs-policy-kit: docs and publication engine.
- ecp-toolkit: the control plane CLI (PLANNED).

Verified 2026-10-22.
